svg.text: Seat pans, cushions, backs, head rests
Carbon fibre, FR foam, wool blend
1. Dimensions in millimetres. Heights above the cabin floor. Do not scale.
2. Seat width 450 between the armrests (spec: 432 to 457).
3. Backs 12° from vertical upright, 17° reclined (5° recline, spec 3 to 6).
4. Mass of the set 23.5 kg without life vests: 7.83 kg a seat (spec: 8 kg).
5. Legs fixed to the seat tracks by 4 track fittings (5) and studs (6),
at any 25.4 mm pitch, so the airline chooses the seat pitch.
6. Each part has its own drawing ESP26-Pnn (nn = item number).
7. Hidden detail left off for clarity: see GA-02 and the part drawings.
Third angle projection. Drawn from the CAD model with hidden line removal.
